description: Subscribe to the live Base pool channel (/v2/sentinel/stream, SSE, 0.01 USDC). Unlike the other five this is a CONTINUOUS channel, not a discrete RPC action: this tool opens it, collects events for a bounded window and returns what arrived, saying so plainly. Reading again is another call. The server applies the same risk and venue filters as sentinel_latest to the pools it pushes; the `hello` event echoes the filter in force, and the result reports it as `filter`.

maxRisk.description: Only pools whose risk score is at most this

minRisk.description: Only pools whose risk score is at least this

windowSeconds.description: How long to hold the channel open (default 15, max 60)

name: sentinel_stream
